activity_summary: You tried the letter out loud and cut it. You kept the three nights as liked, the laugh as once, and the brook as two sentences. You kept nine pounds as a difference. You did not put Richmond, the box, or a house into it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: attendee in Cut the letter to the brook and nine pounds

facets.activity: Tried the letter shorter, out loud

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: If I write the laugh twice it becomes a boast, and a boast is a longer letter.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Nine pounds more. I will not write the box.
